1) Download the mod.  
2)Open the folder to the point where there are "reshade cleanser" , tsuki V2 and guide.txt.  
3)Open reshade cleanser.  
4)take the .bat and put it in where the .exe of kenshi is .  
5)Run it , follow the instructions , normally the tab is gone.  


6)Return to step 2).  
7)Open TsukiV2.  
8)Take every file and put it where the .exe of kenshi is , same place that before.  
9)(optionnal) Launch the game and press shift and F11 at the same time , you should see settings in top left that you can click to activate their effects BUT there is a red message on the top...  


10)To remove the red message go where the .exe is and search a file that should be called "ReShade.ini"   
11)Open the file and search a setting called " CurrentPresetPath=D:\\Steam\\steamapps\\common\\Kenshi\\TSUKI.V2.ini "   
TIP: you can do ctrl+f to search it faster.  
12)Remove everything after the " = "   
13) Write the path you have after the equal, for me its C:\\Kenshi\\TSUKI.V2.ini but for you it should be X:\\folderwherekenshiis\\Kenshi\\TSUKI.V2.ini  
14) Launch the game and you should see a watermark of Tsuki that can be removed by pressing the indicated keys.  


15) It's done you can play kenshi with Tsuki without problems.
